value.description: Geometric grotesque in the DM Sans class (the film names this face on a specimen tile), regular weight, sentence case, centred. Hero size on flat grounds: about 50-55% of frame width for one word (0.0-0.57 s, 27.0-27.9 s; OCR box 0.888 wide by 0.251 high for two words). Typed with a thin caret at 1-3 frames a character.

value.role: small lines over images and canvases
value.description: Same face, regular, sentence case, 2.5-6% of frame height, centred: search-bar query (OCR h 0.067), canvas line, the small 'crafted' line (OCR w 0.31), anchored photo caption (about 10% of width, white), CTA in a pill (OCR w 0.24).
Same face in white chips with a thin dark keyline or dark green pills with lime or white text, chip height about 17% of frame for chapter titles (OCR box 0.47 x 0.17), left-set.
Same face, regular, accent green #0DC45E on pale mint, about 73% of frame width (OCR 0.729 x 0.237), small grey kicker above and unit line below; counters in tiles at 6-10% of frame height.
Last words of a line set in the accent green while the rest stays ink or white (canvas line, 'crafted' line, icon-row sentence).
Client wordmark bold italic, white on green, about 53% of frame width; seen once at 4.1-4.9 s. Fonts are inferred from shapes except the named specimen.

composition.value: Two modes. (1) Single centred subject on a flat or gradient ground with lots of air: typed lines at centre (y 0.45-0.5), a monitor or tablet at centre, the number card at centre; type 25-90% of width depending on whether type is the picture. (2) Dense collage: 6-12 elements in a bento or grid with thin gutters (about 1-2% of width), a held hero element at or near centre (a photo card about 63% wide; a page card about 45% wide) and everything else arriving around it. Split frames for features: left panel about 40% wide with one icon tile, right a photo with small UI chips. Word frames: two small words at the left and right edges framing a centred inset about 45% wide. Nothing is cropped tight except during the canvas punch-in, where the headline overflows both edges on purpose.

materials.value: A deliberate mix bound by the palette: warm overhead and portrait lifestyle photography (hands with devices, people at work, logistics); glossy 3D renders (an iridescent orb, a fan of glass cards, a currency glyph, phones in an isometric array, a monitor on a green studio sweep, a 3D bolt mark); real web page captures shown full frame, in a browser, on a monitor, tablet and phones; flat UI components (chips, pills, tab controls, chat bubbles, checkout cards); a design-tool canvas with selection boxes and named cursors; pastel mesh gradients and a faint globe grid on the final green.

lighting.value: Flat, high-key graphic grounds for type; renders lit as soft studio product shots with glossy highlights and green-tinted reflections; the monitor sits on a brand-green studio sweep with a darker floor (#A7E4C0 to #053618) rather than on black; photography is natural daylight or warm interior light, never graded dark. Overexposed mint-white bloom frames used once as a cut device.

styleSummary: Fresh green fintech brand case study: lime, signal green and forest green with white and near-black, one geometric grotesque in sentence case, and a mix of lifestyle photos, glossy renders and real page captures composed either as one calm centred object or as a dense bento that assembles around a held hero.
